text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer! Thanks for the time 
off!
choice_data_list: Did you enjoy your day off?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A tokusatsu show from before I was 
even born was out on DVD rental!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing! Dangling from helicopters, 
training with dump trucks! Older movies 
really went all out with real physical 
stunts—it's so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Remembering that is getting me all fired 
up again...! Alright, today's training is 
gonna be strict and intense!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Biko Pegasus thoroughly 
enjoyed her day off and feels completely 
refreshed!
